ValidationRule.description: A deployment cannot be marked Deployed while its approval gate is open. Status can only move to Deployed when Approval Status is Approved or Not Required — never while Pending or Rejected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Deployed"), NOT(OR( ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, "Not Required") )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This deployment can't be marked Deployed until it's approved. Approval Status is currently Pending or Rejected — a reviewer must set it to Approved first.
